# sqlpipe v2.0 Release Notes

## Breaking Changes

**User API field rename**: The `/v2/users` endpoint now returns `first_name` and `last_name` instead of the single `name` field. Update client code that reads user data before upgrading.

## New Features

**Incremental sync**: The new `--incremental` flag enables delta-only transfers. sqlpipe tracks the high-water mark between runs and syncs only rows added or modified since the last execution. Useful for large tables where full refreshes are expensive.

## Performance

**Parquet writes 40% faster**: Rewrote the Parquet serialization layer with better buffer management and parallel column encoding. Most noticeable on wide tables (50+ columns) and large batches.

## Upgrade Path

1. Update API clients to handle `first_name`/`last_name`
2. Upgrade sqlpipe binary
3. Run existing pipelines — no config changes required unless using user endpoints
